description: Export tickets incrementally using cursor-based pagination for synchronization, backups, or analytics. Supply a start time for the initial request and use the returned cursor in subsequent requests to fetch further pages.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for incremental ticket export with cursor-based pagination.

cursor.description: The cursor pointer for pagination. Use the after_cursor value from a previous response to fetch subsequent pages of tickets.
cursor.human_parameter_description: Pagination cursor token. Obtain from a previous response's 'after_cursor' value to get the next page of results.
cursor.title: Cursor

start_time.description: The Unix timestamp (seconds since epoch) to start the incremental export from. Must be at least one minute in the past. Data isn't provided for the most recent minute. Required on the initial export request; not required on subsequent cursor-based pagination requests.
start_time.human_parameter_description: Unix timestamp for when to start the export. Must be at least one minute in the past. Required for the first request but optional when using cursor pagination.
start_time.title: Start Time

support_type_scope.description: Filter tickets by support type. Possible values are 'all', 'agent', or 'ai_agent'. Defaults to 'agent'.
support_type_scope.human_parameter_description: Filter tickets by their support type origin - 'agent' (human agent), 'ai_agent' (AI agent), or 'all' (both). Defaults to 'agent'.
support_type_scope.title: Support Type Scope

inputSchema.title: GetIncrementalTicketsCursorRequest

name: get_incremental_tickets_cursor

GetIncrementalTicketsCursorResponse.description: Response for incremental ticket export with cursor-based pagination.

after_cursor.description: Cursor value for the next page. Use this value for the cursor parameter in subsequent requests.
after_cursor.title: After Cursor

after_url.description: URL to fetch the next page of results. Null if this is the last page (end_of_stream is true).
after_url.title: After Url

before_cursor.description: Cursor value for the previous page. Null if this is the first page.
before_cursor.title: Before Cursor

before_url.description: URL to fetch the previous page of results. Null if this is the first page.
before_url.title: Before Url

end_of_stream.description: Indicates whether this is the last page of results. When true, there are no more tickets to export.
end_of_stream.title: End Of Stream

tickets.description: Array of tickets that have changed since start_time
tickets.title: Tickets

GetIncrementalTicketsCursorResponse.title: GetIncrementalTicketsCursorResponse
